acceptanceCriteria.outcome: Every release identity surface matches the derived version and reviewed source checkpoint.
The immutable tag, release assets, attestation, and PyPI distributions contain the verified bytes.
Required profiles pass and an independent reviewer approves the exact candidate with no open finding.

assessments.rationale: The release must preserve its declared compatibility and exact identity surfaces.
The derived identity and published bytes must match the reviewed release contract.
Independent review verifies the generated contract and deterministic release owner.
Release evidence and attestations expose the exact publication outcome.
The reviewed release must publish and recover through the declared automated workflow.
Release authorization adds no product runtime or scaling behavior.
Release metadata contains no personal or sensitive data processing.
Immutable assets and exact external-state checks must fail closed and recover deterministically.
Independent review and merge remain the only publication authorization boundary.
The release binds source, version, artifacts, attestations, and registry bytes.

specification.rationale: The release contract owns the exact public change set and identity surfaces.
